critical_code_review_comments: Deploy-script line-67 fix is correct: getattr(remote, 'resource_name', None) handles the public property (available on modern google-cloud-aiplatform >=1.60 AgentEngine instance) and falls back to remote.gca_resource.name for older/edge builds. Avoids the AttributeError from the removed .api_resource attribute in 1.165.1.

Prior fixes (os.chdir first in main(); extra_packages=['adk_app'] in agent_engines.create) remain intact — ensures cloudpickle resolves the local adk_app package and Vertex staging tar.gz is non-empty.

Serving FastAPI backend does not import deploy_agent_engine or adk_app; the edit has zero blast radius on runtime — confirmed via unaffected /api/agent/health and /api/experiences/{id}/plan responses.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 throwaway experience c3bdbffe-7afc-4fd9-b9fa-8b54d20a96c7 to exercise /plan.
context_for_next_testing_agent: deploy_agent_engine.py is Cloud-Shell-only; never execute here. Static AST/grep + py_compile is sufficient. Plan endpoint expects body {"intent": "<string>"} (PlanIn.intent: str) — not a dict. Golden path latency for /plan is ~20–25s via Emergent Gemini proxy.
rca of the issue: google-cloud-aiplatform 1.165.1 removed the AgentEngine.api_resource attribute; accessing remote.api_resource.name raised AttributeError right after deploy succeeded. Fix uses the stable public property remote.resource_name with a defensive fallback to remote.gca_resource.name. Both are safe because agent_engines.create returns an AgentEngine wrapper exposing resource_name (str) and gca_resource (proto).
